auxiliary_law: Full3N Gaussian with mean x and fixed sigma0.1; physical x in dimension3(N-1).
selection: Both pre-existing capacities and both seeds; no outcome-based checkpoint selection. Reuse the already frozen site/vector controls with identical starts, target, schedule and seed definitions.
cost_contract: EACF training16000 raw calls and source preparation counted;2048 earlier generator-validation calls reported separately, not silently charged as training. Sampling, compile/startup and steady transport times separated. Fixed microsteps/max query caps do not imply equal actual costs.
scope: Development sampling-proposal comparison, not a native unconditional-generator or broad molecular benchmark.
stop_rule: No superiority from a short prefix, missing source density, or mismatched physical targets. Preserve invalid proposals, nonfinite map failures and all negative outcomes.
